bagPolicy.summary: Large backpacks, suitcases, beach bags and equipment bags are prohibited; the theatre does not specify dimensions for smaller bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is on local streets or in nearby paid lots; obey residential parking permits.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The theatre guide does not publish a rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Theatre concessions are cashless, and outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Buy a regular ticket and notify security on show day if an ADA-section chair is required; the venue recommends arriving at or before posted door time. Alternate security screening and service-animal entry are available.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The theatre FAQ and policies do not state whether guests may re-enter after leaving.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Most tickets are delivered through AXS Mobile. The show-day box office opens one hour before doors and charges a $2.50 in-person ticket fee.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Guests pass through walk-through metal detectors; door time is set per show. Quick Pass uses a separate line when public doors open and still requires an event ticket.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
